summary: OFBiz is an enterprise resource planning system that provides a collection of business applications designed for cross-industry use. It functions as a foundational framework for managing core organisational processes such as accounting, inventory, and order fulfilment. The platform is written in Java and licensed under the Apache-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need a customisable, open-source enterprise resource planning foundation that you can adapt to specific business workflows.
watchOut: Enterprise resource planning platforms of this scale typically carry a significant operational burden and a steep learning curve for customisation and maintenance.
deployNotes: Because it is built on Java, you will typically need to allocate sufficient memory for the Java Virtual Machine and run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
